name: RecallGlass
subtitle: Study & printable speaker cues
promotionalText: Create study cards and printable speaker cues from material you provide.
description:
Create study cards and printable speaker cues from material you provide.

Create an academic deck from source text, answer a card and choose your own review grade.

Review an answer suggestion alongside the canonical answer before scheduling the next card.

Create corporate speech cues with stage pacing, pause prompts and a start/pause/reset timer.

Preview and export 3-by-5, 4-by-6 or A6 cutouts on Letter or A4 sheets, with cut and alignment guides.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Document processing and supported Apple Intelligence generation run on device. Optional storage uses your private iCloud container. There is no developer-operated account, advertising, analytics backend or third-party AI API. Supported local/text workflows remain available when a model or speech language is unavailable.

FREE AND PRO
Includes five completed on-device AI actions per app. Pro unlocks additional actions through monthly or annual subscriptions, or a separate lifetime purchase. App Store prices, eligibility and subscription terms are displayed before purchase. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled in App Store settings.

Generated cards and feedback can be incomplete; verify them against the source. The learner chooses the final grade. Print cutouts at actual size and check printer margins. Speech import and recording require consent and supported on-device recognition. The app does not provide third-party study content.
